Q186.reason: Res ipsa loquitur applies because the elevator was under the owner's exclusive control and a sudden fall ordinarily does not happen without negligence, so the case goes to the jury.

Q187.reason: An ordinary commercial sale of gasoline, even with knowledge of the buyer's illegal purpose, is generally not enough for criminal complicity, unlike the more purposeful facilitation in the other options.

Q188.reason: The recorded negative covenant between adjacent-lot owners binds the daughter as a successor with constructive notice, and a gift still transfers the successor interest, so the man can enjoin the shed.
